about_the_game:
Deep in a throbbing headache, you awaken in a strange, unfamiliar room.

A dim light flickers; a lone board game sits quietly at the center.

Rain drums on windows that reveal nothing but swirling fog.

Knowing nothing else, you hear a voice whisper from nowhere.

Make ready. “Let’s all play this mysterious board game together!”

An unshakable sense of dread fills your chest as you reach forward.

Gently, reality begins to melt into fantasy.

Everything fades, and the game begins.

Begin Your Adventure with a Roll of the Dice!

Welcome to “Viractalia”, a charming miniature world where dice determine your path and cards define your destiny.

In this board game-style RPG, movement is ruled by luck, but victory lies in your strategy and deck-building skills.

This demo features a specially designed stage to give you a taste of the game’s core mechanics.

Experience the thrill of exploration and tactical battles—just a step away from your full adventure.

（While the full version features online multiplayer, the demo is limited to single-player only.）

What You Can Experience in the Demo

Explore a Handcrafted Miniature Field

Discover the joy of exploration in a beautifully crafted world.

In the full version, fields are procedurally generated, while the demo features a fixed, handcrafted stage.

Card Battles Meet Board Game Mechanics (with limited features)

Use a variety of cards to overcome your enemies!

Try out basic deck-building and get a feel for the strategic combat that awaits in the full version.

Dice Movement & DP System

Your dice rolls won’t go to waste!

Any leftover movement is converted into DP (Dice Points), which you can spend to enhance battles or trigger events—adding depth to every turn.

Demo Limitations Compared to the Full Version

This demo includes the following limitations:

　・Only a single, handcrafted stage is available

　・Available cards and deck-building features are limited

　・Online co-op play is not supported; solo play only

　・Some characters and events are not included

　・Supported languages: Japanese and English only

Enjoyed the Demo? The Full Adventure Awaits!

The full version includes procedurally generated maps, full access to all cards and characters, and exciting online co-op play.

Your destiny, shaped by the dice and your decisions, is only just beginning.

Step into the complete adventure and let your story unfold!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4690 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 960 / Radeon R7 370
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX2070 / Radeon RX 5700XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Roll the dice, build your deck, and dive into a tactical board game RPG! This demo lets you explore a handcrafted map and try out fast-paced card battles. Your strategy and luck decide your fate!
